prompt: Build the sign-in page from the given content as one centred card on a warm off-white page. Keep it calm and trustworthy: a white card about 400px wide with a thin light border, rounded corners and generous padding. Order inside the card: small uppercase brand line in the brand green, a bold heading, a muted grey line under it, then the two labelled fields stacked with labels above them, a row with the remember option on the left and the forgot link on the right, a full-width dark green button with white text, and a small centred line at the bottom with its link in green. Use a plain system sans-serif font, inputs and button the same height with softly rounded corners. Set the page language, a viewport meta tag, tie each label to its field, and keep the CSS short.
